messages:
anya: Heads-up — nightly eval GHA runs left 3 orphaned jobs overnight, PR gating blocked for ~2hrs :grimacing:
sam: ugh. which workflow? link? :eyes:
anya: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/1234567890 — watcher timed out while waiting for artifact upload, runner stayed RUNNING
matt: can you paste last 20 lines of the runner log? could be the upload step stuck on s3 connection
anya: pasted the snippet below
```
Uploading artifacts to actions...
INFO: starting upload to s3://redwood-evals/nightly/2026-03-19/
ERROR: ConnectionResetError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer
Retrying upload (1/5)
Retrying upload (2/5)
...
Upload stalled, process not exiting, runners still marked busy
```
li: that looks like the upload coroutine isn't propagating the exception back to GH action runner. we saw similar with older aws-sdk versions in buildkite agents
sam: infra-bot, did we recently roll the gha-runner image? :question:
infra-bot: deploy: gha-runner v2026.03.10 rolled last night to 10 hosts — no anomalies reported in cluster metrics
ci-bot: workflow-warning: cancel-in-progress not honored on queued builds due to missing run_id propagation (see run 1234567890)
matt: ah — the action that cancels stale runs needs the run_id env to be forwarded from the dispatcher. looks like the nightly dispatcher spawns a parallel matrix and then forgets to pass run_id to child jobs
anya: so result = multiple child jobs attempt upload, one fails and never signals, cancel step never triggers because it doesn't know the parent run id
li: quick mitigation: add a timeout wrapper on upload step and fail fast so runner frees itself. also add retry with exponential backoff + an explicit exit on repeated failures
sam: for PR gating: can we make GH Actions treat stalled runners as failed faster? maybe reduce watchdog to 10m for eval workflows
matt: +1. i'll open a tiny PR in .github/workflows/nightly-evals.yml to add timeouts on the upload step and propagate run_id via env: PARENT_RUN_ID=${{ github.run_id }}
anya: i'll create a tracking issue and assign to eng-infra to audit runner image aws sdk version and add the timeout to the runner wrapper
li: can we also add a Buildkite fallback? if GH actions flakes, route the nightly evals to dedicated buildkite agents for that job class
sam: agree, but that's a bigger change. short-term: patch GH workflow, disable strict PR gating for affected tests for one rollout window, and monitor
ci-bot: ticket-created: https://issues.redwood-inference.com/INFR-4275 — gha orphaned-eval-jobs, assignees: matt, li
infra-bot: scheduled: run canary redeploy of gha-runner with aws-sdk pinned to 1.26.4 tonight at 02:00 UTC
anya: action items:
- matt: PR to add timeout & propagate run_id (ETA today EOD)
- li: audit runner image + report (ETA tomorrow morning)
- sam: toggle gating rule for eval-nightly (temporarily) and post in #eng-security (ETA 30m)
- anya: monitor next night run and update ticket

matt: will post link to PR once open :thumbsup:
li: thanks — adding logs to the issue now
anya: thanks everyone. ping me if you see additional stuck runs. :pray:
